statement: At pinned SDL Switch HIDAPI revision 535d80b, simple input report 0x3F parses two button bytes, one hat, and four little-endian 16-bit stick axes. The SDL simple-axis calibrator explicitly treats raw axis code 0x8000 as neutral before mapping extrema. A source-derived UHID simple-mode encoder must offset signed controller-native axes into this unsigned center representation; zero-filled stick fields are not neutral. This is a consumer parser requirement, not a measured retail neutral frame.

applicability.revision: SDL Switch HIDAPI 535d80b; no physical hardware or retail firmware measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_switch.c 137-152, 1107-1122, 2183-2257. Consumer-only simple report structure and neutral parser; no Bluetooth descriptor or physical calibration inferred.
